fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of "aspnet_compiler.exe" which can be abused to compile and execute C# code.
fields.name: AspNetCompiler Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm64\\") and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\aspnet_compiler.exe"))
